correctness.rationale: BV derivative measure gives an exact finite-degree jump reduction; conditional binomial/beta transition moments and fixed-iterate Gaussian limits yield the full central jump profile. A uniform Chebyshev integral bound excludes endpoint jumps, the unique maximum of t(1-t) enforces median localization, and Minkowski with a strict external gap proves all near-extremal variation concentrates at the median. Uniform-norm extremal lower bound follows from continuity of non-atomic Markov transition at the zero boundary. Exact check.py gives 266 rational assertions and 16 numerical comparisons, not used as an infinite proof.
